recognize_zh: 組合圖中 B 可見大型多形性細胞與多核 Reed-Sternberg 樣細胞，易被誤認為古典何杰金淋巴瘤；但 C-F、H 免疫染色中大型細胞呈片狀強陽性，G 可見成片的大型腫瘤細胞，右下 TRG 基因重組分析出現單株峰，支持 T 細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）。
features: Panel A: low-power H&E with diffuse effacement by a mixed cellular infiltrate
Panel B: large pleomorphic cells including multinucleated Reed-Sternberg-like cells
Panels C-F: immunostains with strong staining of large neoplastic cells in cohesive clusters and sheets (antibodies not labeled)
Panel G: cellular area with sheets of large atypical cells
Panel H: strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of sheets of large cells
TRG capillary electrophoresis showing a dominant clonal peak
describe_en: This composite figure shows a lymph node effaced by an infiltrate that on low power (A) is mixed, but at high power (B) contains large pleomorphic cells including multinucleated Reed-Sternberg-like forms. Immunostains (C-F, H; specific antibodies not labeled in the figure) highlight large neoplastic cells in cohesive clusters and sheets rather than scattered isolated cells, and a separate area (G) shows sheets of large atypical cells. T-cell receptor gamma PCR demonstrates a clonal peak. The combination of sheet-like growth and T-cell clonality favors anaplastic large cell lymphoma mimicking classic Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation with CD30, ALK, EMA, CD15, PAX5, and T-cell markers is required.

ddx.vs: cHL shows scattered HRS cells that are PAX5 weakly positive, CD45-negative, and lack clonal TCR rearrangement, rather than sheets of CD30-positive T cells.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks uniform strong CD30 and hallmark cells, and HRS-like B cells in PTCL are EBV-positive bystanders.
These are morphologically similar and are separated by ALK immunohistochemistry or ALK rearrangement studies.
